summary: The UK benefits department confirmed a serious cyber incident and took most of its online services offline. Allstate's outage is still unexplained. No official source links these events or reports a coordinated attack. Bitcoin and oil look like normal market moves.

events.title: UK benefits department takes most online services offline after cyber incident
events.impact: Universal Credit accounts, PIP applications, pension services and Tell Us Once are down online. Regular payments continue. Outside the US.
events.stated_cause: The department says a cyber incident, and it shut services as a precaution. The minister says he cannot yet say what caused it. Who did it is unknown.

events.title: Allstate website, app and roadside help outage continues into day 6
events.impact: Some customers and agents still cannot pay, renew, file claims online or get roadside help online. Allstate says no one loses coverage or pays late fees. No restore time given.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Allstate has not said what caused it. No official source reports a cyberattack on Allstate.

sources.name: Wall Street Journal via Yahoo Finance

events.title: Reports of a hack of an Air Force cloud system; Pentagon says its systems are secure
events.impact: AFP and Federal News Network report a breach found earlier this year by contractors. The Pentagon will not confirm it and will not discuss network status. Impact is unknown.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Reports rely on anonymous sources. No official source confirms a breach.

events.title: 1Password confirms attacker used an employee GitHub account to reach backend systems
events.impact: Some customer names, emails and account details were copied, plus private source code. 1Password says vaults and passwords were not reached. No newer update found this run.
events.stated_cause: An attacker got into an employee GitHub account. How they got in and who they are is unknown.

events.title: SAP confirms a security incident in its GitHub development systems
events.impact: SAP restricted GitHub access and replaced signing keys. It has found no sign customer business data was reached. Media say code was copied; SAP has not confirmed that. No newer update found.
events.stated_cause: Der Spiegel's sources say stolen employee tokens were used. SAP has not confirmed this. Who did it is unknown.

events.title: Cloudflare dashboard and API problems; status page shows degraded service today
events.impact: Dashboard and API requests failed for some customers. Cloudflare says sites behind it kept loading. Its status page still showed Sites and Services as degraded at 09:23 UTC today.
events.stated_cause: Cloudflare has not said what caused it. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: Wyoming uranium plant still shut after cyber incident
events.impact: Peninsula Energy shut its Lance plant after plant and wellfield control systems were hit. No restart date. No newer update found this run.
events.stated_cause: The company calls it a cybersecurity incident. It has not said who did it or how.

events.title: Tanker attacks near Hormuz and Houthi strikes on Saudi sites keep oil near 96 dollars
events.impact: Brent crude was about 96 dollars Friday, up about 5 percent for the week after falling about a quarter earlier in November. Another report puts it near 95 today. No oil market halts found.
events.stated_cause: UKMTO confirmed a tanker was hit near Khasab. Iran says other tankers hit mines; that is not independently confirmed. The Houthis claim strikes on Saudi energy sites.

events.title: Bitcoin about 59.5K to 61.6K USD; no crash found
events.impact: Coinbase 61,463. CoinMarketCap 61,563. CoinGecko 59,498. Sources differ on the 24-hour move, from about +1.3 to -3.5 percent. Down about 24 percent over a month, not sudden. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Reports cite ETF flows, rate worries and a tech stock rebound.

events.title: FAA shows no ground stops or system outages
events.impact: The FAA feed lists only routine airport closures to some private and military aircraft. No delays or ground stops.
events.stated_cause: None needed. No official source reports a cyber attack on air traffic systems.

events.title: CISA adds 3 actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers OSGeo GeoServer (two flaws) and Drupal Core. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive. No newer CISA notice in the feed.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and links the flaws to no incident above.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The UK benefits department says a cyber incident hit it, but not who or how. Allstate has not said why its systems are down. 1Password and SAP both report GitHub account break-ins, yet no official source names one attacker or links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems in different sectors failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: No confirmed link between events and no official report of a coordinated attack.

prep_note: No action is needed for most people. Allstate customers can pay and file claims by phone. UK benefit claimants should use the phone lines, and watch for scam messages claiming to be from the DWP. Use strong, unique passwords and turn on two-step sign-in.
